title: The benefits of craft making
paragraphs: Are you good with your hands? Many of us like to make things which we can use or give as gifts. Crafting is certainly a hobby that’s seen a resurgence, and those who pursue it claim getting creative improves their mood.

The recent lockdowns caused by the Covid pandemic gave people time at home to try out new activities, which they’ve continued to enjoy. Many turned to hobbies such as craft making as a way to soothe their work-from-home burnout. Knitting, crocheting, pottery and painting are all crafts that have seen a revival, and many of them are being done by younger people.

But even before the pandemic, people were turning to arts and crafts as an interesting pastime and even a way to make a bit of pocket money. Numerous websites, such as Etsy and Folksy, allowed people to sell their handmade goods. Richard Sennett, author of the Craftsman, told the BBC that: “A lot of people are finding their day jobs pretty empty, whereas learning a craft provides a real satisfaction. It’s a skill – things like carpentry and weaving are mentally and physically stimulating, and people get inherent pleasure out of that kind of work”.

The internet has also been the place to turn to to buy craft kits which help you get started with your craft-making projects, such as candle making or macrame. But many people are enjoying designing and making things from scratch and are doing it just for pleasure or to occupy their minds – and there’s evidence that it’s good for us as well. According to research commissioned by BBC Arts, even the briefest time spent on a creative pastime such as painting, pottery or playing the piano, has an impact on our wellbeing and emotions. The survey of around 50,000 people found being creative can help avoid stress, free up mind space and improve self-development, which helps build self-esteem.
So, if you’re looking for the perfect tonic for your stressed-out life, maybe now’s the time to get creative.

vocabulary.entry: good with one's hands /ɡʊd wɪð wʌnz hændz/ 擅长手工的
vocabulary.example: My grandfather is very good with his hands and can repair almost anything.
vocabulary.translation: 我祖父非常擅长手工，几乎什么东西都能修。

vocabulary.entry: resurgence /rɪˈsɜːdʒəns/ n. 复兴；再度流行
vocabulary.example: There has been a resurgence of interest in traditional folk music recently.
vocabulary.translation: 近来人们对传统民间音乐的兴趣再度兴起。

vocabulary.entry: pursue /pəˈsjuː/ v. 从事；致力于
vocabulary.example: She decided to pursue her hobby of painting and became a professional artist.
vocabulary.translation: 她决定潜心钻研绘画爱好，成了一名职业画家。

vocabulary.entry: soothe /suːð/ v. 缓解；抚慰
vocabulary.example: Listening to soft music can soothe your nerves after a long day at work.
vocabulary.translation: 漫长的工作日后，听轻音乐可以舒缓你的神经。

vocabulary.entry: work-from-home burnout /ˌwɜːk frəm həʊm ˈbɜːnaʊt/ 居家办公倦怠症
vocabulary.example: Many people suffered from work-from-home burnout during the long lockdown period.
vocabulary.translation: 长时间的封锁期间，很多人都患上了居家办公倦怠症。

vocabulary.entry: knitting /ˈnɪtɪŋ/ n. 针织；针织品
vocabulary.example: She finds knitting a relaxing activity that helps her unwind in the evening.
vocabulary.translation: 她觉得针织是一种放松的活动，能帮她在晚上舒缓身心。

vocabulary.entry: crocheting /ˈkrəʊʃeɪtɪŋ/ n. 钩针编织
vocabulary.example: Crocheting allows you to make a variety of items from scarves to blankets.
vocabulary.translation: 钩针编织可以让你制作从围巾到毛毯的各类物品。

vocabulary.entry: pottery /ˈpɒtəri/ n. 陶艺；陶器制作
vocabulary.example: She attends a pottery class every weekend to learn how to make ceramic bowls.
vocabulary.translation: 她每周都去上陶艺课，学习制作陶瓷碗。

vocabulary.entry: revival /rɪˈvaɪvl/ n. 复苏；复兴
vocabulary.example: The town has seen a revival of its local market thanks to new vendors joining in.
vocabulary.translation: 随着新摊主的加入，这个小镇的本地集市迎来了复苏。

vocabulary.entry: pastime /ˈpɑːstaɪm/ n. 消遣；娱乐活动
vocabulary.example: Reading is a popular pastime for people of all ages.
vocabulary.translation: 阅读是各个年龄段人群都喜爱的消遣方式。

vocabulary.entry: pocket money /ˈpɒkɪt ˈmʌni/ n. 零花钱
vocabulary.example: The boy earns pocket money by helping his neighbour walk the dog every day.
vocabulary.translation: 这个男孩每天帮邻居遛狗来赚取零花钱。

vocabulary.entry: handmade goods /ˌhændˈmeɪd ɡʊdz/ n. 手工制品
vocabulary.example: The market is full of handmade goods such as jewellery and candles.
vocabulary.translation: 这个集市上摆满了珠宝、蜡烛之类的手工制品。

vocabulary.entry: carpentry /ˈkɑːpəntri/ n. 木工活；木工业
vocabulary.example: His carpentry skills are excellent—he built a beautiful bookshelf for his study.
vocabulary.translation: 他的木工手艺很棒，为自己的书房打造了一个漂亮的书架。

vocabulary.entry: weaving /ˈwiːvɪŋ/ n. 编织；纺织
vocabulary.example: Weaving is a traditional craft that has been passed down for generations in her family.
vocabulary.translation: 编织是她家代代相传的传统手艺。

vocabulary.entry: mentally and physically stimulating /ˈmentəli ənd ˈfɪzɪkli ˈstɪmjuleɪtɪŋ/ 身心兼具刺激性的
vocabulary.example: Gardening is a mentally and physically stimulating activity for the elderly.
vocabulary.translation: 园艺对老年人来说是一项能同时锻炼身心的活动。

vocabulary.entry: inherent pleasure /ɪnˈhɪərənt ˈpleʒə(r)/ n. 内在乐趣
vocabulary.example: There is an inherent pleasure in creating something with your own hands.
vocabulary.translation: 亲手创造东西会带来一种内在的乐趣。

vocabulary.entry: craft kit /ˈkrɑːft kɪt/ n. 手工套装
vocabulary.example: She bought a candle-making craft kit to try making scented candles at home.
vocabulary.translation: 她买了一套手工蜡烛制作套装，打算在家尝试做香薰蜡烛。

vocabulary.entry: macrame /məˈkrɑːmeɪ/ n. 绳结编织（工艺）
vocabulary.example: Macrame is often used to make decorative items like wall hangings and plant hangers.
vocabulary.translation: 绳结编织常被用来制作壁挂、植物吊篮之类的装饰品。

vocabulary.entry: from scratch /frəm skrætʃ/ 从零开始；从头做起
vocabulary.example: She made the cake from scratch instead of using a pre-made mix.
vocabulary.translation: 她没有用预制粉，而是从零开始做了这个蛋糕。

vocabulary.entry: occupy one's mind /ˈɒkjupaɪ wʌnz maɪnd/ 占据思绪；打发时间
vocabulary.example: Puzzles are a great way to occupy your mind when you have nothing to do.
vocabulary.translation: 没事做的时候，拼图是打发时间、活跃思维的好办法。

vocabulary.entry: wellbeing /ˈwel biːɪŋ/ n. 身心健康；幸福安康
vocabulary.example: Regular exercise is essential for maintaining physical and mental wellbeing.
vocabulary.translation: 规律运动对维持身心健康至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: self-development /ˌself dɪˈveləpmənt/ n. 自我发展；个人成长
vocabulary.example: Taking online courses is a good way to promote self-development after work.
vocabulary.translation: 下班后参加网课是促进自我发展的好途径。

vocabulary.entry: self-esteem /ˌself ɪˈstiːm/ n. 自尊心；自我价值感
vocabulary.example: Completing challenging tasks can help boost your self-esteem significantly.
vocabulary.translation: 完成有挑战性的任务能显著提升你的自尊心。

vocabulary.entry: tonic /ˈtɒnɪk/ n. 慰藉物；滋补品
vocabulary.example: A walk in the park is the perfect tonic for a stressful day.
vocabulary.translation: 在公园散步是缓解压力的绝佳方式。

vocabulary.entry: stressed-out /ˌstrest ˈaʊt/ adj. 压力大的；疲惫不堪的
vocabulary.example: Stressed-out workers often turn to hobbies to relax and recharge.
vocabulary.translation: 压力大的上班族常常通过培养爱好来放松身心、恢复精力。

sentences.chinese: 爱好手工制作的风潮再次兴起，而那些投身其中的人表示，发挥创造力能让心情变得更好。

sentences.english: The recent lockdowns caused by the Covid pandemic gave people time at home to try out new activities, which they’ve continued to enjoy.
sentences.chinese: 最近由新冠疫情所引发的封锁，让人们有了居家时间去尝试新活动，而这些活动也被大家一直延续了下来。

sentences.english: Many turned to hobbies such as craft making as a way to soothe their work-from-home burnout.
sentences.chinese: 许多人选择手工制作这类爱好来缓解居家办公带来的倦怠感。

sentences.chinese: 编织、钩针、陶艺和绘画这些手工技艺都迎来了复兴，并且其中不少爱好者都是年轻人。

sentences.english: But even before the pandemic, people were turning to arts and crafts as an interesting pastime and even a way to make a bit of pocket money.
sentences.chinese: 但其实在疫情之前，人们就已经将手工艺当作一种有趣的消遣方式，甚至是赚点零花钱的途径了。

sentences.english: Numerous websites, such as Etsy and Folksy, allowed people to sell their handmade goods.
sentences.chinese: 像爱Etsy和Folksy这样的众多网站，都为人们售卖手工制品提供了平台。

sentences.english: Richard Sennett, author of the Craftsman, told the BBC that: “A lot of people are finding their day jobs pretty empty, whereas learning a craft provides a real satisfaction.
sentences.chinese: 《匠人》一书的作者理查德·桑内特在接受BBC采访时表示：“很多人觉得自己的日常工作十分空虚，而学习一门手艺却能带来实实在在的满足感。

sentences.english: It’s a skill – things like carpentry and weaving are mentally and physically stimulating, and people get inherent pleasure out of that kind of work”.
sentences.chinese: 这是一种技能——像木工和编织这类手艺，既能锻炼脑力，又能活动身体，人们能从这类劳作中获得一种内在的愉悦感。”

sentences.english: The internet has also been the place to turn to to buy craft kits which help you get started with your craft-making projects, such as candle making or macrame.
sentences.chinese: 互联网也成了人们购买手工材料包的好去处，这些材料包能帮你开启各类手工项目，比如制作蜡烛或是编织挂毯。

sentences.english: But many people are enjoying designing and making things from scratch and are doing it just for pleasure or to occupy their minds – and there’s evidence that it’s good for us as well.
sentences.chinese: 不过也有很多人喜欢从零开始设计和制作物件，他们做这些只是为了消遣，或是让自己有事可做——而且有证据表明，手工制作对我们自己也大有裨益。

sentences.english: According to research commissioned by BBC Arts, even the briefest time spent on a creative pastime such as painting, pottery or playing the piano, has an impact on our wellbeing and emotions.
sentences.chinese: 英国广播公司艺术频道委托开展的一项研究显示，哪怕只是花很短的时间投入一项创意消遣活动，比如绘画、陶艺或是弹钢琴，都会对我们的身心健康和情绪状态产生积极影响。

sentences.english: The survey of around 50,000 people found being creative can help avoid stress, free up mind space and improve self-development, which helps build self-esteem.
sentences.chinese: 这项涵盖约5万人的调查发现，发挥创造力有助于缓解压力、放空思绪、促进自我成长，而这些都能帮助提升自信心。

sentences.english: So, if you’re looking for the perfect tonic for your stressed-out life, maybe now’s the time to get creative.
sentences.chinese: 所以，如果你正在为自己压力满满的生活寻找一剂良方，或许现在就是动手发挥创造力的好时机。
